text: the scale is massive and my scaling ability seems to only be positive scaling not negative can you fix that [Image #1]
resolution: Reworked Scale By around usable authoring values: default is ×1.25 with presets ×0.5, ×1.25, ×2, and ×−1. The UI now explains negative scale as mirroring through the selection pivot. Updated the native mesh-edit exact-value path to accept signed factors (while drag scaling remains positive), with unit coverage for negative mirroring and invalid zero/out-of-range values. Verified TS tests, pinned Zig mesh-edit tests, editor bundle, and ReleaseFast native editor build.
